Novyy Starodub Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Kirovohrad Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This record contains a contradiction worth flagging: it is categorized as demolished and overbuilt, yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' According to the Novyy Starodub rural council, this cemetery was demolished in 1918 by the Austro-Hungarian army and later built over sometime after 1970; a local resident, who confidently identified the former cemetery's location, recalled that street construction began in 1979 and that locals openly took tombstones for various purposes at the time, with some possibly still located on private properties in the village.
